description_good_justification: The README and https://aemard.github.io/prowl/ open with what Prowl does: a Chrome side panel that shows the live state of your GitHub pull requests, notifies on changes and lets you act on them.
interact_justification: The README links the Chrome Web Store listing and the releases (obtain), GitHub issues with bug and feature templates (feedback) and CONTRIBUTING.md (contribute).
contribution_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md: issues first for bigger changes, then pull requests that pass pnpm verify, with Conventional Commits.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conventions: TypeScript strict, Biome formatting and lint, tests with every change, accessibility (axe), design tokens, no HTML from GitHub text.
documentation_basics_justification: README (install, sign in, features, privacy), the sign-in guide (docs/auth.md), the install guide on https://aemard.github.io/prowl/install/, and docs/ for architecture and decisions.
documentation_interface_justification: Prowl's external interfaces are its UI, its permissions and the GitHub API calls it makes. The README and docs/privacy.md document the permissions and data; docs/auth.md the sign-in inputs; docs/architecture.md every GitHub query and mutation Prowl sends.
sites_https_justification: The repository, website (GitHub Pages) and downloads (GitHub releases, Chrome Web Store) are HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues: searchable, each issue has a URL, anyone with a GitHub account can take part, no proprietary client needed.
english_justification: All documentation, code comments and issue templates are in English.
maintained_justification: Active development: weekly dependency updates, releases v1.0.0 to v1.3.1 in October 2026, security review entries in docs/security/review.md.
repo_track_justification: Git on GitHub records every change with its author and date; main takes changes only through pull requests with signed commits.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is merged to main between releases; release-please keeps an open release pull request.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique Semantic Versioning number (v1.0.0 to v1.3.1), also in the manifest.
version_semver_justification: SemVer, derived from Conventional Commits by release-please.
version_tags_justification: Every release is a vX.Y.Z tag; a ruleset forbids moving or deleting them.
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub release pages summarize each release's features and fixes.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has fixed a publicly known vulnerability (CVE or similar) in Prowl's own code. Fixed advisories would be listed in the release notes and a GitHub security advisory (SECURITY.md).
report_process_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/issues/new/choose (bug report and feature request templates), described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
report_responses_justification: No bug report has been submitted yet; the maintainer watches the issue tracker and answers every report.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request has been submitted yet; requests are answered in the issue tracker.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/security/advisories/new, as SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md say; the issue chooser links it too.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report received in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to an answer within 7 days.
build_justification: pnpm build (Vite) rebuilds the extension from source; pnpm zip packages it. Release zips rebuild byte for byte (docs/releasing.md).
build_floss_tools_justification: Every build tool is FLOSS (Node.js, pnpm, Vite, TypeScript, Biome).
test_justification: Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests against the built extension, MIT like the code. pnpm verify runs everything (CONTRIBUTING.md); CI runs it on every pull request (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
test_invocation_justification: pnpm test, pnpm e2e and pnpm verify, the standard npm-scripts way: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#check-your-work
test_most_justification: Over 1,300 unit tests and over 100 end-to-end tests; coverage is about 99% of statements, with CI gates at 80% overall and 95% for the GitHub client and diff engine.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs lint, types, unit tests with coverage gates, build, size budget, end-to-end tests and Lighthouse on every push and pull request; Verify is required to merge. https://github.com/aemard/prowl/actions/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md#conventions: every new feature and every bug fix comes with tests, a fix with one that fails without it; CI enforces coverage.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent features came with tests, e.g. pull request #32 (token expiry, SAML notice, Trusted Types E2E check, merge dialog blockers).
tests_documented_added_justification: The pull request template asks to confirm that new behavior and fixes come with tests; CONTRIBUTING.md states the policy.
warnings_justification: TypeScript in strict mode and Biome (lint with the recommended rules plus a11y and security rules) in CI (biome ci).
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any type error or Biome error; main has none.
warnings_strict_justification: strict: true, no any, Biome a11y rules at error level, noDangerouslySetInnerHtml as an error.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least privilege (manifest permissions locked by tests, no host access beyond GitHub), fail-safe defaults (strict CSP with Trusted Types, URL allowlist), complete mediation of untrusted GitHub data and a STRIDE threat model: docs/security/threat-model.md.
know_common_errors_justification: The threat model lists the extension's common vulnerability classes (XSS through untrusted text, token leaks, open redirects, over-broad permissions, supply chain) with a mitigation and test for each.
crypto_published_justification: Prowl implements no cryptography; HTTPS and storage are provided by Chrome.
crypto_call_justification: Prowl implements no cryptography; Chrome handles TLS.
crypto_pfs_justification: Prowl implements no key agreement; Chrome's TLS to GitHub provides forward secrecy.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Prowl stores no passwords of external users.
crypto_random_justification: Prowl generates no cryptographic keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: Delivered through the Chrome Web Store and GitHub releases over HTTPS; release zips carry a signed build provenance attestation (gh attestation verify).
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP; release integrity is checked through Sigstore-signed attestations over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched vulnerability: pnpm audit --prod reports none, Dependabot and dependency review run on every change.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Advisories are fixed as soon as they are known (e.g. the toolchain advisories of October 2026, docs/security/review.md).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in the repository: tests use fake tokens, and the store upload signs in to Google through OIDC (Workload Identity Federation) instead of a stored key.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-extended queries, JavaScript/TypeScript and Actions) runs on every pull request, every push to main and weekly, and is required to merge; Biome lints every change.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security-extended suite covers XSS, injection, insecure URL handling and the other common JavaScript vulnerability classes.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL findings are fixed or triaged as false positives with a reason (docs/security/review.md).
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every commit to a pull request and to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Playwright end-to-end tests drive the built extension in Chromium against a mock GitHub (with axe accessibility scans), and fast-check fuzzes the trust boundaries (tests/unit/fuzz.test.ts), before every release.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Prowl is written in TypeScript, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and fuzzing run with assertions throughout (Vitest and Playwright expect, property checks); production builds carry none.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Failures found by end-to-end tests or fuzzing block the pull request until fixed.
dco_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits-and-pull-requests: every commit is signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin (https://developercertificate.org/), and the required Verify check fails a pull request with a commit that is not (bots excepted): https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
governance_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md: one maintainer decides, discussion happens in public issues and pull requests, and decisions are recorded with their reason in docs/decisions.md.
roles_responsibilities_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles: maintainer, contributors, AI agents and bots, who holds each role and what it does.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity: the maintainer's GitHub account names a successor who can take over the repository, issues, pull requests and releases; the release process lives in the repository (docs/releasing.md), and the code is MIT-licensed.
bus_factor_justification: One maintainer for now. https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity covers the loss of that person.
documentation_roadmap_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/status.md#roadmap: what Prowl plans to do and not do from November 2026 to October 2027.
documentation_architecture_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/architecture.md: module map, data flow, contracts and every GitHub query and mutation.
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/security/threat-model.md (what Prowl protects, how, and the accepted residual risks) and https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/privacy.md (data and permissions).
documentation_quick_start_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/README.md#install: add from the Chrome Web Store, pin, sign in.
documentation_current_justification: Docs live in the repository and change in the same pull request as the code. The website renders the sign-in guide, privacy policy, changelog and contributing guide from the repository files, and tests/unit/siteAccess.test.ts fails if docs/privacy.md misses a permission.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/README.md shows the OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges under the links.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/accessibility.md: keyboard reachable and labelled controls, focus-trapping dialogs, color never the only signal; axe reports zero violations in the end-to-end tests.
internationalization_justification: English only for now (https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/decisions.md); dates and times use the browser's locale. Localization is on the roadmap: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/status.md#roadmap
sites_password_security_justification: The project's sites (GitHub, GitHub Pages, Chrome Web Store) store no passwords of their own.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Only the latest release is supported (https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions); Chrome updates store installs automatically, and each version reads the settings of the previous one (normalizeSettings), so upgrading needs no step.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability was reported or fixed in the last 12 months; https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to crediting reporters in the advisory.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/SECURITY.md: private reporting through GitHub, an answer within 7 days, a fix in a patch release with a GitHub security advisory crediting the reporter.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conventions and https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/biome.json (Biome formatting and lint rules), TypeScript strict.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: biome ci and tsc run in the required Verify check (.github/workflows/ci.yml); a pull request that breaks them cannot merge.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native code: Vite bundles TypeScript into JavaScript, so compiler and linker variables do not apply.
build_preserve_debug_justification: No native code or install step; pnpm dev builds with source maps for debugging.
build_non_recursive_justification: One Vite build for the extension and one Astro build for the website; no recursive build.
build_repeatable_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#verify-a-release: a release rebuilt from its tag with the frozen lockfile gives the same zip, byte for byte.
installation_common_justification: Installed and removed through the Chrome Web Store (Add to Chrome, Remove from Chrome), or loaded unpacked from a release zip.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Chrome installs the extension into its profile; there is no install path to set.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up: clone, pnpm install, pnpm build, load dist/ unpacked.
external_dependencies_justification: package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml list every dependency, and each release ships an SBOM.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot version updates every week and security alerts, and dependency review on every pull request: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#dependencies
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Every reused component is an npm package pinned by the lockfile and updated by Dependabot; no code is vendored.
interfaces_current_justification: Manifest V3 and current chrome.* and GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs; Dependabot keeps dependencies on their current versions.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: Every push and pull request runs the unit tests and the Playwright end-to-end tests against the built extension (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conventions: a bug fix comes with a test that fails without it. Of the four fix commits of the last six months, three added tests; the fourth repaired an import after a merge.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: 99.5% statement coverage (pnpm coverage, 2026-10-30); CI fails below 80% overall and 95% for src/lib/github and src/lib/diff (vitest.config.ts).
test_policy_mandated_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conventions: every new feature and every bug fix comes with tests.
implement_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/security/threat-model.md#assurance-case: how Prowl applies each Saltzer and Schroeder principle.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: Prowl implements no cryptography; Chrome negotiates TLS.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The GitHub token is stored apart from the code (chrome.storage.local) and is replaced by signing in again, with no rebuild.
crypto_used_network_justification: Prowl talks only to https://api.github.com and https://github.com; the CSP connect-src allows nothing else.
crypto_tls12_justification: All traffic is HTTPS through Chrome, which supports TLS 1.2 and 1.3.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Chrome's fetch verifies TLS certificates, and an extension cannot turn that off.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Requests go through fetch over HTTPS, which verifies the certificate before any header, the token included, is sent.
signed_releases_justification: Each release zip has a Sigstore-signed provenance attestation and bundle; https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#verify-a-release shows how to verify them.
version_tags_signed_justification: release-please creates the tags through the GitHub API, unsigned; a ruleset forbids moving or deleting them, and the release attestation ties each zip to the tagged commit.
input_validation_justification: Allowlists at every trust boundary: URLs (isGitHubUrl), label colors, token characters, team keys, settings (normalizeSettings), message senders: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/security/threat-model.md
hardening_justification: CSP without unsafe-* and with Trusted Types, no remote code, a manifest permission lock enforced by tests, credentials: 'omit' on every request, and a CSP on every page of the website.
assurance_case_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/security/threat-model.md#assurance-case: threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles and the common weaknesses countered, with the evidence.
build_reproducible_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#verify-a-release: anyone can rebuild a tag and get the same zip, byte for byte.
security_review_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/security/review.md: reviews against the threat model in October 2026, including one by a separate review agent that did not write the code.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: GitHub requires two-factor authentication for every account that contributes code, and GOVERNANCE.md requires it of any maintainer.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: Collaborators join only by the maintainer's invitation, with a role chosen by hand, the lowest their work needs: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The main ruleset requires a pull request: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#recommended-repository-settings
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The main ruleset forbids deleting the branch: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#recommended-repository-settings
osps_br_01_01_justification: Workflows pass event data (branch names, titles, tags) to shells only through env: variables, never interpolated into scripts, and none uses pull_request_target.
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull request workflows get a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN with persist-credentials: false and no pull_request_target; the store credentials exist only in the chrome-web-store environment, which runs on releases after a person approves.
osps_br_03_01_justification: The repository, website (GitHub Pages), releases and Chrome Web Store listing are HTTPS only.
osps_br_03_02_justification: Releases are distributed over HTTPS (GitHub releases, Chrome Web Store) with a Sigstore provenance attestation: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#verify-a-release
osps_br_07_01_justification: The repository holds no secret: workflows use GITHUB_TOKEN and Workload Identity Federation, configuration is in repository variables, and .gitignore excludes .env files.
osps_do_01_01_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/README.md and the guides on https://aemard.github.io/prowl/ (install, sign-in, privacy).
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests, open to anyone.
osps_le_02_02_justification: Released under the MIT License, OSI-approved.
osps_le_03_02_justification: Each GitHub release carries the source archives, which contain LICENSE, next to the extension zip.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: Git on GitHub records every change with its author and date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml at the repository root.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: One repository: the extension, its tests and the website (site/) all live in aemard/prowl.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executables: dist/ and release zips are git-ignored and built by CI.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are PNG images (icons rasterized from src/assets/logo.svg by pnpm icons, screenshots), which can be viewed and reviewed.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/SECURITY.md: report privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Every workflow sets read-only top-level permissions (contents: read, or read-all for Scorecard) and grants write per job only where needed.
osps_br_02_01_justification: Each release has a unique SemVer version and vX.Y.Z tag set by release-please.
osps_br_04_01_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and the release notes of each GitHub release.
osps_br_05_01_justification: pnpm installs build dependencies from pnpm-lock.yaml with --frozen-lockfile.
osps_br_06_01_justification: Each release zip has a Sigstore-signed provenance attestation: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#verify-a-release
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit is signed off under the DCO (https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits-and-pull-requests), and the required Verify check fails a pull request with a commit that is not (bots excepted).
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The main ruleset requires the Verify and CodeQL Analyze checks to pass: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#recommended-repository-settings
osps_qa_06_01_justification: Verify runs the unit and end-to-end tests on every pull request, and merging requires it.
osps_sa_01_01_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/architecture.md (side panel, service worker, storage, GitHub) and the data flows of https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/security/threat-model.md
osps_sa_02_01_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/architecture.md lists every GitHub query and mutation; https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/docs/privacy.md the permissions and data.
osps_vm_01_01_justification: https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/SECURITY.md: private reporting, an answer within 7 days.
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Fixed vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories (https://github.com/aemard/prowl/blob/main/SECURITY.md); none so far.
